title: Pranayama for Daily Anxiety Relief: A Beginner's Guide
excerpt: Learn 3 powerful ancient breathing techniques to calm your nervous system in less than 4 minutes whenever stress strikes.
author: Subina Aacharya
content: Your breath is the direct remote control to your autonomic nervous system. By consciously altering the duration and depth of your inhalation and exhalation, you can instantly shift from a stress-induced state into calm parasympathetic rest.
